notes: Probed https://www.gandul.ro/robots.txt (200, permissive, Disallow only /wp-admin/; names Sitemap: /sitemaps/index.xml and /sitemaps/news-sitemap.xml). Tried /sitemaps/news-sitemap.xml (200): only 177 items, newest-first, only back to 2026-10-24, so it cannot cover the 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 window. /sitemaps/index.xml (200) lists ~100 numbered posts-N.xml files whose lastmods are scattered across 2012-2026 (e.g. posts-20 = 2026-02-16, posts-66 = 2026-02-17), so there is no ordered set of files to binary-search and entry lastmod is not a reliable publish date. Final route: WordPress REST API (site is WP despite the custom look; /wp-json/ not disallowed by robots). GET /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?_fields=date,link&per_page=100&after=2026-09-24T00:00:00&before=2026-10-26T00:00&page=N, all 200, 36 pages, paginated until a short page (79) at page 36; after/before are interpreted by WP on the local post_date column, hence the 1-day margin each side, then the date part of the LOCAL 'date' field is filtered to the window. Listed date = local 'date' (Europe/Bucharest): verified against an article page (post 21043364: REST date 2026-10-24T09:00:56 == page JSON-LD datePublished 2026-10-24T09:00:56+03:00; the page's article:published_time meta is the same instant in UTC). Result: 3449 unique URLs, all 31 days, 2026-09-30=139, 2026-10-10=93, 2026-10-20=122 (min 77). Self-test: re-fetched 4 sample articles, visible text 8165-15305 chars (all >1500) and page date (both UTC meta and local JSON-LD) matched the listed date with 0-day difference. No 403/429/WAF encountered, no retries needed.
